subject: grad
title: GRAD.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 67 (BK(NM)-43). GRAD (gradualism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From TRS: RT-ALGN (reality alignment), RT-INF-TR and INFO-CON (information convergence). From RT-ALGN: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From INFO-CON: RE-ST (restructuralism). From T-C-IMP: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics).
